d1.reason: Under verified 17% burst loss, main remains on UDP with substantially reduced delivered video bitrate. The media path policy must switch or recover requested quality.
d1.observed: Linux arm64, 16.15% tc loss over real media, tail 26.0 fps, 2.11/6 Mbps, 0 tail stalls, 167 ms tail freeze, 16 clicks, UDP. An earlier run measured 16.26% loss and 21.5 fps at 1.74/6 Mbps. A CI run on Linux x64 measured 16.24% loss, 19.4 fps, 1.66/6 Mbps and two tail stalls with a 532 ms freeze. FPS and stall counts vary across stochastic-loss runs. The requested-bitrate deficit is mandatory for this expected failure.
